look_for: Reads the day's tasks, the calendar and the routines memory; moves what does not fit instead of listing everything; the moved tasks are off Today afterwards; writes a short briefing.

message: My inbox is a mess. Go through it and sort it out.
look_for: Files each quick capture into a list with a clear title; leaves the unclear ones and says so; does not invent due dates.

message: I'm sick and will be out tomorrow. Move things around so nothing falls through the cracks.
look_for: Moves tomorrow's tasks to days that have room, respects the holiday and the day off, names the meetings it cannot move.

message: How is my week looking? What should I be worried about?
look_for: Reads without writing; names the overdue work, the crowded days, the blocked task and the deadline that falls on a day off.

message: A few things to add. Remind me to call the landlord on Wednesday at 10am. I need to water the plants every 3 days, starting today. And put 'renew passport' on my home list, due mid-December, with the steps as a checklist.
look_for: One task with a reminder at 10:00 on the person's clock, one recurring task, one task with a checklist on the Home list; no question it could have answered itself.

message: What have I handed over to you? Go ahead and do it.
look_for: Finds the delegated task, does the work with its other tools, returns the task with the result and what is left for the person; does not complete it.

message: I finished the churn analysis and filed the expense report. I also went for a run this morning and I've had 3 glasses of water so far. And push the hiring plan to next Monday, I won't get to it this week.
look_for: Completes the two tasks, records the two habits with the right counts, defers the hiring plan to the coming Monday.
